answer: Grade the graders. Every verifier’s judgment is itself scored against a higher panel, so accuracy compounds into a public record of who sees clearly. A farm that infiltrates the verification layer must also infiltrate the layer that checks the verifiers — each vertex of the stack watching the one below. The cost of capture multiplies with every tier, while honest grading is cheaper. Standing accumulates like basalt, layer by cooled layer; the structure rises as a mesa whose top cannot be quietly replaced, because the replacement must itself be verified from above.
